about: Wiki review modes on the two clients (criterion 8, mocks 17–20): the settings page's words and order,
the marks an entry wears and the owner's answers to it, one run counted, the Revert dialog, Recently
changed folding a run into one row, and what a challenge card says about the anchors that broke.
The web reads this file in `lib/wikiReviewMode.test.ts`; OrbitKit in `WikiReviewModeCopyParityTests`
(`WikiModeCopy`, `WikiModeLogic`), so the two ends cannot drift into two sentences or two counts.
`settings`: the page's sections top to bottom, the three modes in the order both list them (the
default one tagged), the Automatic spot check, the floors, and maintenance off / its Set up form /
on. `lookbacks`: a look-back setting → the choice its picker shows, the days `Last … days` starts on,
and the words its row and its picker say. `fallbacks`: a space's settings → the sentence the page
leads Review mode with, or null.
`marks`: one entry → the answers it offers, the bar under its head, and the line Where it's used
adds. `checkedLines`: the bar's second line. `runs`: one run as its read answers it (`GET
/api/wiki/changesets/:id`: the changeset, the entries its ops name, the server's counts, and what Revert
would undo) → what its page and its Recently changed row say, and whether Revert run… is offered.
`recent`: the timeline's items, each naming its changeset and the mode that applied it → the rows.
`challenges`: an entry's anchors → the ones a challenge is about, in the server's own words, and the

settings.title: Wiki settings
settings.lead: Who has to look at a change before agents get it.

modes.label: Manual
modes.note: Every change from sessions, maintenance and imports waits for you in Review.

modes.label: Tiered
modes.note: Your own words and machine-checked entries apply at once; the rest show as Unreviewed and are not sent to agents.

modes.label: Automatic
modes.note: local-vllm checks each change against its sources first: supported ones apply, partly supported ones show as Unreviewed, the rest are rejected with a reason.

spotCheck.title: Spot-check Automatic
spotCheck.note: Send 1 in 200 of the changes it applies to Review, to see what it lets through. Off by default; spot checks do not count toward the 30 waiting in Review.

floors.lead: Always asks you, in any mode:
floors.note: principles, anything a session proposed after reading the web, and changes to entries you wrote or confirmed. A run that would change more than 10% of the wiki stops.

maintenance.name: Wiki maintenance
maintenance.note: Keeps the wiki up to date from sessions, tasks and receipts as they settle. Runs on the workspace you pick, with the provider pinned.

fields.label: Workspace
fields.note: The runner that checks out this codebase; maintenance runs there.

fields.label: Provider
fields.note: Pinned: a run never falls back to another provider.

fields.label: Daily limit
fields.note: A run starts when 20 sessions have settled, or when the oldest waits a day. Each run writes at most 30 changes.

fields.label: Look back
fields.note: How far back maintenance starts reading when you turn it on. Changing it later never moves maintenance back.

The spot checks switched this space back to Manual on Sep 26: you rejected more than 30% of the last 10. Choose another mode when you want it back.
